description:
The DK Nano Balance bike is a great way to introduce your child to the world of bicycle riding without the use of training wheels or a tricycle. The DK Nano has been designed from the ground up to meet the needs of children and parents alike.
Key features include a low-profile frame with a 12” top tube and an integrated foot platform, an alloy riser handlebar, 1” threadless headset, and fork, 12” alloy wheels with inflatable tires, and adjustable padded seat. With a balance bike (also known as a “push bike”) your child will learn the fundamentals of balance and bicycle control first, making the transition to pedal bike much easier.
*The DK Nano stand-over height is adjustable from 11.75” to 14.25” from the top of the seat to the ground.
